actions: Activate flood irrigation today to maintain a 5‑10 cm water layer across the field; monitor water depth hourly for the first 48 h.
Conduct a thorough field scouting within 24 h to identify symptoms of blast, sheath blight, or leaf spot and assess nutrient deficiency signs.
Apply well‑composted organic manure (≈10 t ha⁻¹) uniformly across the field within the next 3 days to increase organic carbon.
Re‑apply balanced NPK fertilizer at the recommended rate after the irrigation stabilizes, following local extension guidelines.
Install soil moisture sensors (tensiometers) at 15 cm depth to guide irrigation scheduling; aim for soil moisture >70 % of field capacity.
Record all interventions in a farm log and capture GPS‑tagged photos of crop condition.

Monthly market price review to adjust harvest timing and sales strategy.
